description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Tree house requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Tree house draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional tree house requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RevisedDraft" name="Revised tree house draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsOrder" name="Materials order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the tree house"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartyInvitation" name="Tree house party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_BuildingHouse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect" processRef="Process_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineStores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialRequirements" name="Send requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Start_Architect_Initial"
                      messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Return draft"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Start_Architect_Additional"
                      messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedDraft" name="Return revised draft"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedDraft" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MaterialsOrder" name="Order materials"
                      sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_OnlineStores"
                      messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed"
                      sourceRef="Participant_OnlineStores" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"
                      messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Message friends to build the house"
                      sourceRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartyInvitation" name="Send party invitations"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildingHouse" name="Building a House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_BuildingHouse">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_WantToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeDrafts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RefinePlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAdditionalRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MessageFriendsToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AttendeeListCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WantToBuild" name="Want to build a tree house">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_SendRequirements</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to the architect"
                   messageRef="Message_Requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_SendRequirements</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendRequirements_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from the architect"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendRequirements_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveDraft_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft" name="Receive revised draft from the architect"
                      messageRef="Message_RevisedDraft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveRevised</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveRevised_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeDrafts" name="Merge received drafts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveDraft_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveRevised_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_MoreRequirements</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreRequirements" name="More requirements to add?"
                           default="Flow_NoMoreRequirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_MoreRequirements</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MoreRequirements_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoMoreRequirements</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePlan" name="Refine the plan with additional requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MoreRequirements_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine_SendAdditional</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements to the architect"
                   messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine_SendAdditional</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveRevised</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from the plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoMoreRequirements</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateList_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order categorized materials from several online stores"
                   messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateList_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit" name="Wait for order processing while messaging friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_OrderProcessed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_MessageFriends</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_OrderProcessed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderProcessed_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderProcessed"
                                  messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" name="Message friends to build the house"
                   messageRef="Message_BuildRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_MessageFriends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MessageFriends_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin" name="Order processed and friends messaged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderProcessed_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MessageFriends_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_SendInvitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations to friends"
                   messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_SendInvitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AttendeeList_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AttendeeListCreated" name="Party attendee list created">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AttendeeList_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_WantToBuild" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_SendRequirements" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRequirements_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDraft_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_MergeDrafts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveRevised_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft" targetRef="Gateway_MergeDrafts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_MoreRequirements" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeDrafts" targetRef="Gateway_MoreRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreRequirements_Refine" name="Additional requirements needed"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRequirements" targetRef="Task_RefinePlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moreRequirements</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoMoreRequirements" name="No additional requirements"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRequirements" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_SendAdditional" sourceRef="Task_RefinePlan" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveRevised" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_OrderProcessed" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_MessageFriends" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit" targetRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderProcessed_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Event_OrderProcessed" targetRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MessageFriends_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_MessageFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_SendInvitations" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_CreateAttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Architect" name="Architect prepares and returns drafts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Architect">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Architect" name="Tree house architect">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Architect_Initial</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_DraftSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Architect_Additional</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviseDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRevisedDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RevisedDraftSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Architect_Initial" name="Receive initial requirements">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchitectInitial_Prepare</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_InitialRequirements"
                                  messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDraft" name="Prepare tree house draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchitectInitial_Prepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Prepare_SendDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft to you" messageRef="Message_Draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Prepare_SendDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendDraft_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DraftSent" name="Draft sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendDraft_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Architect_Additional" name="Receive additional requirements">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchitectAdditional_Revise</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AdditionalRequirements"
                                  messageRef="Message_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseDraft" name="Revise tree house draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchitectAdditional_Revise</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Revise_SendRevisedDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedDraft" name="Send revised draft to you" messageRef="Message_RevisedDraft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Revise_SendRevisedDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendRevisedDraft_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RevisedDraftSent" name="Revised draft sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendRevisedDraft_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchitectInitial_Prepare" sourceRef="Start_Architect_Initial" targetRef="Task_PrepareDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_SendDraft" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDraft" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendDraft_End" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="End_DraftSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchitectAdditional_Revise" sourceRef="Start_Architect_Additional" targetRef="Task_ReviseDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Revise_SendRevisedDraft" sourceRef="Task_ReviseDraft" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRevisedDraft_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedDraft" targetRef="End_RevisedDraftSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
